fixed: Turning a custom field's Searchable setting off now keeps its values out of the search bar as well as the Filters panel, so a private note no longer turns up in an All fields search.
Searching for "true" or "false" no longer matches every dance that has a yes/no field set. Find a yes/no value with its filter instead.
data_migrations: On first launch after updating, the search index is rebuilt for the dances holding a value in a yes/no field or in a field with Searchable off. No dance data is changed.

fixed: `dance_fts.custom_values` and `dance_substring_fts.custom_values` carry only the values of live definitions with `searchable` on and a type other than `boolean` (`customFieldIndexesValueText`).
added: `CustomFieldDefRepository.onIndexedValuesChanged`, wired by `CompendiumRepositories`, reindexes the dances holding a value when a non-sync write changes whether a definition's values are indexed; `DanceRepository.reindexDancesHoldingCustomFields` does the reindex.
A one-shot `ensureMigrated` pass behind `customFieldIndexRepairDoneKey` reindexes the dances an index written before this rule still carries such values for.
